# TH3RD GROUP

TH3RD GROUP LLC is a strategy, technology and execution company for consumer brands and growing businesses. The company works in English and Spanish. Services are scoped to the business objective, evidence and responsibilities agreed for the engagement.

Services: https://th3rdgroup.com/solutions/

Contact: hello@th3rdgroup.com

## TH3RD Compass

Compass supports product research, source evidence, market readiness, commercial relationships and follow-up work. Its public interactive reports use fictional data; they are not client records, regulatory approvals or measured commercial outcomes. Operational access, source records and human review require an agreed scope.

English: https://th3rdgroup.com/compass/
Español: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/compass/

## Scope boundaries

Audits, sprints and fractional support are engagement formats, not additional services. Market-entry planning covers the commercial path; product and market readiness reviews product, packaging and document evidence. Conventional workflow automation and AI-assisted tasks are distinct choices; AI requires defined sources and human review.

TH3RD GROUP does not claim to represent retailers and does not guarantee placement, distribution, regulatory approval, compliance or commercial outcomes. Market-readiness work is preliminary and does not replace qualified legal, regulatory, laboratory or certification advice. Channel availability and responsibilities must be confirmed for the specific market.

Full reference: https://th3rdgroup.com/llms-full.txt
